zh.headline: 具百人團隊實戰經驗的技術長：為企業打造能扛大盤的好系統
zh.subHeadline: 管理超過 100+ 人團隊，處理過大型商務系統開發和調整；懂戰略也能挽起袖子在第一線寫 Code 解決核心技術痛點。

body.text: 十多年跨國技術管理與系統開發經驗。曾帶領 100+ 人工程團隊完成跨國大型商務系統微服務重構，並整合全球 CRM / ERP 與售後流程，將退換貨處理時間從數天縮短至數分鐘。能和經營層聚焦業務營運目標，也親自參與架構檢視與程式碼審查，專注幫公司解決系統瓶頸、穩定交付。
給不諳技術老闆的 5 大安心承諾（我如何為您免除疑慮）
1.「工程師講話我都聽不懂，開口閉口只會跟我要錢買機器、招人、搞微服務重構。」
說人話、算細帳：只用商業回報與成本效益溝通，把技術名詞翻譯成大白話。優先從現有系統排查瓶頸與清理冗餘，檢視雲端帳單幫公司省錢，絕不盲目要預算或浮誇擴編。
2.「問他何時上線，永遠說在還技術債；一到業務高峰或關鍵活動，系統照樣當機給你看。」
生意優先、營運不中斷：技術重構絕不能影響日常做生意。提前做好架構瓶頸排查、分流降級與容災備援方案，以「系統高可用、守住核心營運」為最高底線。
3.「自命清高、態度傲慢，覺得老闆沒懂技術是笨蛋。」
尊重業務第一線：技術的存在本來就是為了成就商業。深知做生意的辛苦與利潤的不易，虛心傾聽營運需求，絕不搞技術自嗨。
4.「這個人好不好溝通？我講我的生意經，他聽得懂嗎？還是會用一堆技術黑話唬我？」
聽得懂生意經：歷練過大型商務與跨國電商營運，聽得懂商業邏輯與賺錢算盤；溝通只聚焦「這項投入能解決什麼具體營運卡關」，不拿名詞堆砌距離。
5.「他是正派的人嗎？會不會做一做拍拍屁股跑掉？我怎麼知道他不是吹牛的？」
陽光透明、愛惜羽毛：百人團隊實績與跨國系統可受檢驗，180+ GitHub 專案與線上系統長期公開透明；堅守「不做博弈、加密幣與高風險灰色產業」，正派穩健，跑得了和尚跑不了廟。
合作項目
1. 年度企業技術顧問（一年期顧問約）
適合需要系統重構、跨系統整合、整理技術債或擴編團隊的企業。以一年期顧問方式，依約定頻率（每週或雙週）參與技術決策與架構檢視、規劃電商與 CRM/ERP 資料串接、檢討雲端成本，並協助面試與培育技術主管。
2. 技術長 / 研發部門負責人（CTO / VP of Engineering）
開放跨國企業、上市櫃公司、零售電商或科技公司的技術管理職缺。負責技術規劃、100+ 人工程團隊管理、大型商務系統與核心平台改版，提升團隊交付穩定度。
3. 技術盡職調查與系統診斷（Tech Due Diligence）
為投資人與企業提供投資或併購前的第三方技術評估——依標的資料完整度，約 1–2 週交付系統架構、程式碼品質與資安設定檢視報告（屬技術評估，非法律意見）；或針對業務高峰流量瓶頸、跨系統資料不同步等問題提供改善方案。
主要經歷與線上作品
跨國大型商務零售集團（帶領 100+ 人工程團隊）：負責大型電商平台與微服務架構改版，整合跨國多幣別結帳、會員與庫存同步流程。
跨國消費性電子品牌（跨系統整合）：串接客服、Salesforce、HubSpot、RingCentral 語音系統與 ERP / RMA 退換貨流程，將跨部門人工傳遞的退換貨處理時間從數天縮短至數分鐘。
180+ GitHub 開源專案與主力線上系統：個人 GitHub 累積超過 180+ 開源專案與實戰工具；並長期維運 5 大主力線上系統，包含 888 StockBot 2.0 股票估值分析、888 StockQuant 時間序列預測平台、888news 科技情報彙整與遠端 MCP 服務、DAVID888 Daily 語音 Podcast，以及 333 奇門遁甲曆法決策網站。
合作方式：一年期企業技術顧問｜正職技術主管 (CTO / VP of Engineering)｜技術盡職調查 (Tech DD)。

en.headline: An Experienced CTO with 100+ Team Scale: Building Resilient Systems for Enterprise Growth
en.subHeadline: Led teams of 100+ engineers with deep experience architecting and refactoring enterprise commerce platforms; combining strategic vision with hands-on code to solve core technical bottlenecks.

body.text: Over a decade of enterprise technology leadership and software engineering experience. Led a 100+ engineer team refactoring an international enterprise commerce platform and streamlined cross-border CRM/ERP workflows, reducing return processing time from days to minutes. Equally comfortable aligning technical direction with executive leadership and working side-by-side with engineers on architecture reviews and code.
For Non-Technical Executives: 5 Core Commitments (Addressing Your 5 Biggest Concerns)
1. "Engineers speak in jargon, asking for budget, machines, and microservices."

Speak Business, Not Jargon: Translate technical choices into ROI and budget impact. Prioritize resolving bottlenecks in existing infrastructure before asking for headcount or expensive cloud expansion.
2. "Always 'paying tech debt'; systems still crash during mission-critical business peaks."

Business Continuity & High Availability: Technical refactoring must never disrupt core operations. Architect proactive failovers, graceful degradation, and load-shedding to guarantee enterprise stability and zero downtime during critical business moments.
3. "Arrogant engineers who think business leaders don't understand tech."

Grounded Respect for Frontline Operations: Technology exists solely to serve commercial success. Respect the challenges of running a profitable business, listen deeply, and avoid tech self-indulgence.
4. "Can this person communicate? Will they understand our business model?"
Decades of Enterprise Experience: Extensive background in commercial and retail operations; discussions focus on solving operational bottlenecks, never hiding behind acronyms.
5. "Are they trustworthy? Will they walk away leaving a mess?"

Public Accountability & Reputation: Verifiable track record leading 100+ teams and public maintenance of 180+ GitHub repositories; strict personal policy against gambling, crypto, or grey-market schemes.
Engagement Options
1. Annual Technical Advisor (12-Month Retainer)

For companies planning system refactoring, cross-system integration, technical debt cleanup, or team expansion. I work with leadership on a 12-month retainer to review architecture, connect e-commerce and CRM/ERP data flows, optimize cloud costs, and help interview and mentor engineering leads.
2. CTO / VP of Engineering

Open to full-time technology leadership roles at multinational corporations, listed groups, retail/e-commerce enterprises, and technology companies. Responsible for technical direction, managing 100+ person engineering teams, and improving platform stability and delivery.
3. Technical Due Diligence & System Review

Independent pre-investment or pre-M&A technical reviews for investors and companies—delivering a 3-pillar report covering architecture, codebase quality, and security/compliance within 2 weeks; or diagnosing traffic bottlenecks and data sync issues.
Experience & Live Systems
International Enterprise Retail Group (Led 100+ Engineering Team): Refactored enterprise commerce platform and microservices architecture across multi-currency checkout, loyalty, and inventory sync.

Global Consumer Electronics Brand (System Integration): Connected customer support, Salesforce, HubSpot, RingCentral voice, and ERP/RMA workflows, reducing manual return processing from days to minutes.

180+ GitHub Repositories & Flagship Live Systems: Maintained 180+ open-source GitHub repositories alongside 5 flagship live systems—888 StockBot 2.0 (equity valuation), 888 StockQuant (time-series forecasting), 888news (automated tech intelligence & MCP), DAVID888 Daily (automated audio podcast), and 333 Qi Men Dun Jia (calendar calculation engine).
Available for: 12-Month Technical Advisor Retainers, Full-Time CTO / VP of Engineering roles, and Technical Due Diligence. No gambling, Ponzi, or illegal projects.
